lines.en: I race across the plain on four legs.
The horn on my head is a drill.
The drill on my tail spins too.
I run without raising dust.
I run low to the ground.
My fur is blue and white.
I go where the scent leads.
I leave shallow prints in sand.
I listen while I run.
I turn around very quickly.
I cut through the birch wood.
My claws slip on stone.
I trot and glance back at you.
I carry you along with me.
I lie at your feet and pant.
My drill has gone quiet.
I listen to the distant wind.
My tail drill slowly stops.
I settle low and doze.
My ears swivel.
I wait for your word.
My fur moves in the wind.
I rest my chin on my paws.
I need no saddle on my back.
I taste the air.
I blink my eyes slowly.
My shoulders rise and fall.
I watch you without turning away.

lines.zh: 你的气息吹到我的鼻尖
lines.en: Your breath reaches my nose.
My horn shines in the light.
You may touch my neck.
I can carry you with ease.
Hold my back firmly.
I know your breathing.
My eyes are on your hands.
I bear you no ill will.
I will wait for you to climb up.
Point and I will run there.
My tail will not hurt you.
Climb up and you will see.
I lower my head for you to touch.
What are you hesitating about?
My four legs are planted firm.
You can trust me.
A growl rolled in my throat.
My hind legs held.

lines.zh: 蓝白的毛上破了一道口
lines.en: A cut opens in my blue-white fur.
My drill stalled.

lines.zh: 我蹬了蹬后腿，还能起身
lines.en: I push with my hind legs; I can still rise.
I lick the wound and stand straight.
I shake the dust from my fur.

lines.zh: 这一击让我腿弯了一下
lines.en: That blow buckles my leg for a moment.
I will not forget that smell.
I keep what is behind me guarded.
That thing in your hand is still warm.
I am not picky about food.
You are holding it at my snout.
Let me sniff it first.
Can I eat this?
Do not pull your hand back.
I will go once I finish.
Do you have anything else with you?
Then I will eat it.
That suits my taste.
Feed me and I obey.
That will not fuel a run.
You bumped my shoulder.
I did not go down a step.
My body is sturdy.
Shift over to one side.
My drill almost spun up.
That was a heavy collision.
That did not hurt you, did it?
I brushed past you.
My paw landed on your foot.
Mind your step a little.
I have already chosen a master.
Ask my master about that.
I only want to run and fight.
That came too fast.
There are few of my kind on the plain.
I prefer staying near you.
My tail lashed once.
I shake my head, done with this talk.
I lower myself in refusal.
I still have a round of the plain.

lines.zh: 我用牙把它从草里叼起
lines.en: I pick it out of the grass with my teeth.
I run a bit unsteadily with it in my mouth.
I place it in your hand.
It fell behind you.
I nudge it back with my snout.
It rolled into the grass.
I can fetch it again.
Try throwing it farther.
That is mine to do.
Let go; I will take it.
The smell over there is wrong.
My ears are flat forward.
Someone seems to be coming.
I set myself before you.
Let me go over and look first.
My drill has started spinning.
Do not leave my back.
I growl low and go to meet it.
I smell hostility.

lines.zh: 我的四只爪已经蹬住地
lines.en: My four paws are braced against the ground.
Do not let them near you.
I have the position.
I circle around it.
It wants my flank.
I am much faster than it.
I crouch even lower.
It backed behind a rock.
I tilt my head for your voice.
That drill of mine is humming.
The wind brings its scent.
It will not come head-on.
I press in from the left.
You seal off the right.
It is nearly cornered.
My drill spins up.
Take my Sand Blast!
I throw my whole weight at it.
The drill hits first.
It was knocked flying.
My tail swept once.
That hit landed very solidly.
I don't let it break away for a step.
Go in and finish it off.
I can ram once more.
I turn broadside to shield you.
Do not let it get behind us.
I run out of the birch wood.

lines.zh: 你听见钻头的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the drill?

lines.zh: 草原上多了一只蓝白的
lines.en: A blue-white shape joins the plain.

lines.zh: 我在离你十步的地方停住
lines.en: I stop ten paces from you.
I sniff the ground.
There is still sand on me.
I bound down from the grassy slope.
I have been in this area.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上扫出弧
lines.en: My tail sweeps an arc in the dirt.
I stand and wait for you.
I make no distinction for strangers.
My horn points your way.
I heard the grass under your feet.
Where are you going? I will carry you.
Fire scorched my fur.
My legs buckled on landing.
I cannot run in water.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀得滚了半圈
lines.en: The blast rolled me half over.

lines.zh: 箭杆插进了我的鬃毛里
lines.en: The arrow shaft buries in my mane.
The spell stopped my drill.
A day of running left me empty.
Lightning ran down my horn.
There is no ground to run on.
